name: Luna
source: While similar to the protagonist in personality, Luna shares neither the porn addiction or the kinks. This makes her as innocent as a girl can be, as she has no experience with boys and has never even kissed before. She works at a local cafe along with Violet, who frequently teases Luna for her naive nature.
